title: 1036. Escape a Large Maze

examples.explanation: The target square is inaccessible starting from the source square because we cannot move. We cannot move north or east because those squares are blocked. We cannot move south or west because we cannot go outside of the grid.
Because there are no blocked cells, it is possible to reach the target square.
